description: This Java source file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, capturing specific exceptions and returning structured HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and error messages.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring REST controller advice class that handles various exceptions globally and returns custom error responses.

methods.name: handlePropertyReferenceException
methods.description: Handles PropertyReferenceException by returning a 400 Bad Request with details about valid properties.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgumentException
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException with a 400 Bad Request response indicating invalid request parameters.

methods.name: handleMethodArgumentTypeMismatch
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException for parameter conversion errors, returning 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: handleGenericException
methods.description: Handles all other unexpected exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error with a generic message.
